_comment: catalog blocks (the manifest-only columns of contract:plugins.catalog) for licensed registry entries that nself-org/bundles scripts/registry-carry.json carries without one. scripts/plugin-counts.sh adds a block only to an entry that lacks one, until the expiry date; after it the script fails. Remove an entry when its owner_ref lands in bundles and the manifest generates its own block. Values come from the entry's v1 manifest (status stable = maturity implemented).
